verdict.rationale: LibreChat exposes a public OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and a documented (beta) Agent Management API for creating/updating/deleting agents and machine-client OIDC auth, showing a genuine programmatic surface beyond the chat UI. However the API is explicitly labeled beta, documentation for it is thin compared to the rest of the docs, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of its stability or completeness. Missing for 10: mature (non-beta) API docs with usage examples, independent developer confirmation of API stability, broader API coverage beyond agents.
